book.name: Markos
book.title: Ka Maroyow No Nangnangonon No Insulat Ni Markos Bahin Ki Hisu Kristu

content: Ka Pogwali ni Huan no Talagbautismu
Soini ka Maroyow no Nangnangonon bahin ki Hisu Kristu no anak to Magboboot.
Un-unawa ka kagi to insulat dongan ni Isaias no talagnangon to kagi to Magboboot. “Kagi to Magboboot, ‘Nò, ogpohun-oon ku koykow ka suguanon ku oyow kandin ka ogpanagana to dalan no ogbayaan nu.’
No duon ka sika suguanon dio to holholawan no ogbabansagon. Kagi rin, ‘Lantasi now woy gawhani now ka ogbayaan to Lagboy no Igbuyag ta oyow ogkatul-id.’ ”

Nò man, ian ka poglibuwas ni Huan no Talagbautismu dio to holholawan no ognangonnangon. Kagi rin, “Sonditi now ka goinawa now to mgo salo now woy ongkori now ka mgo maroot no batasan now woy ogpabautismuan kow no ogpasayluan kow to Magboboot.”

Ko dio pad to woig to Hordan si Huan, nanghondio kandin ka mohon-ing no mgo otow no nigpuun dio to mgo lunsud, mgo hilit duon to probinsia to Hudia lagkos to mgo otow no taga Hirusalim no lunsud. Ko nig-abin dan ka mgo salo dan dio to Magboboot, nigbautismuan ni Huan sikandan dio to woig to Hordan.
Ka kinabo ni Huan, pighabol to bulbul to ayam no oghingaranan to kamil woy ka nagangu no laplap to ayam ka pighimu to igholonon din. Ka igkouyag din, talangas woy tonob.
Nignangonan ni Huan ka mgo otow to, “Duon ogpakasundul koddi no dakoldakol pad koddi ka katondanan din. Doisok ka koddi no katondanan agad to oghokad to mgo sandal din.
Ogbautismu a kaniu to woig di sikandin ogbautismu kaniu pinabayo to Gimukud to Magboboot.”
Ka Pogbautismu ni Hisus
Pila ro no allow no nigpuun si Hisus dio to lunsud to Nasarit duon to probinsia to Galilia no nokouma dio ki Huan oyow ogpabautismu sikandin ki Huan dio to woig to Hordan.
Poggakap do ni Hisus, niglonghag sikandin dio to langit no nigkita rin no napulasan ka langit woy ka Gimukud to Magboboot no ogpokohulughulug no ogkounawa to salapati dio to kandin.
No duon kagi no nigpuun dio to langit no kagi rin ki Hisus “Sikoykow ka koddi no anak no igkarakoli to goinawa ku no dakol ka igkarago ku koykow.”
Nig-ol-ologan ni Satanas si Hisus
No, sikan do no magaan nigparuma to Gimukud to Magboboot si Hisus dio to holholawan.
Dio nig-ugpo to kahop-atan no allow no oggawayan porom sikandin ni Satanas
to ogpakasalo porom. Di waro makasalo. Songo duon dio ka mgo magintalunan no mgo ulod di nigtalipun sikandin to mgo diwata no suguanon to Magboboot.
Ka Pog-alam ni Hisus to Hop-at no Talagngangalap
To pogkapirisu ni Huan, nighondio to probinsia to Galilia si Hisus no dio din nangoni ka mgo otow bahin to Maroyow no Nangnangonon puun to Magboboot.
Kagi rin, “Natuman on ka mgo allow to Magboboot no magaan on ogbunsud ka Pogsugu din. Sonditi now woy ongkori now ka mgo salo now no tuui now ro ka Maroyow no Nangnangonon.”
No, nighihipanow on si Hisus dio to ilis to lanow no oghingaranan to Galilia no nigkita rin si Simon woy si Andres no patalahari no ogpanaraya dut ilis to lanow su talagngangalap man sikandan.

Kagi ni Hisus kandan to, “Duma kow koddi su og-anaron ku sikaniu. Og-anaron ku sikaniu ko ogmonuon now to og-alap to otow kai to koddi oyow ogkohimu sikandan no mgo sakup ku.” No, sikan do ian pig-agpas dan galata ka taraya ran no nigduma on ki Hisus.

Nigparagas nighipanow woy si Hisus no nigkita rin ka dangob no darua no patalahari duon dod to balutu dan no ogbalbalawan dan ka mgo sigay ran. Si Santiago woy si Huan ka ngaran dan no ian mgo anak ni Sibidiu.
Pogkita ni Hisus sikandan, nig-umow rin sikandan oyow ogdumoon din sikandan. No, ingalat dan ka amoy ran duon to balutu duma to sikan no mgo binayaran no nigduma on ki Hisus.
Ka Lukos no Pigbusawan
Nokouma on si Hisus mgo hibatoon din dio to lunsud to Kapirnaum. Ko Allow to mgo taga Hudia to Oghimoloy, nigsolod sikandan to anaranan to mgo og-ampu no nig-anad ni Hisus ka mgo otow dio.
Noinuinu ka mgo otow to pog-anad ni Hisus su dakol ka katondanan din no og-anad no kono no unawa to mgo Talag-anad to Balaod.
Pog-anad ni Hisus dio to anaranan to mgo og-ampu, nigsolod ka sagboka no lukos no pigbusawan on.

Nigbabansagon din to, “Wow Hisus no taga Nasarit, nokoy ka labot nu kanami no mgo busow? Nighondini kad buwa oyow og-ubuson koy nikoykow. Nokoila a koykow; koykow ka matuwarong no nigpuun to Magboboot.”
Di nigsaparan ni Hisus ka busow no kagi rin, “Hagtong kad no ogkagi; libuwas kad kai to diralom to soin no lukos.”
Nò, impabiidbiid to busow ka sika lukos no nigngangang to maagbot no niglibuwas on.
Noinuinu ka tibo no mgo otow no nigmoin-insooy to, “Nokoy buwa ka soini? Iam no ig-anad ian! Duon kabogbogan to soin no lukos to agad ko ogdogilon din ka mgo busow, ogbabali sikandan.”
Nò man, magaan nakalogob ka pogkabantug ni Hisus to agad hondoi no lunsud dio to Galilia.
Nigbawian ni Hisus Ka Mohon-ing no mgo Otow
Puun to sika anaranan to mgo og-ampu, nighipanow si Hisus mgo hibatoon din woy ki Santiago woy si Huan dio to baloy ni Simon woy si Andres.
Dio to baloy nighibathibat ka boi no anogang ni Simon su moinit lagboy so lawa rin. Pogkouma ni Hisus nignangonan on sikandin bahin to sikan no nigdaralu.

Nigdanian ni Hisus ka nigdaralu no niggongonan din ka bolad din no nigbuligan din sikandin to og-onow. Nigparagas nigsasindog su noulian on ka dalu rin no sikan do ian no nigpakoon din si Hisus mgo duma rin.
Ko mahapun on no magaan on ogkatangkob on, nanduma to mgo otow ka tibo no duma ran no nandaralu woy ka pigbusawan.
Nalimudlimud ka tibo no mgo otow to lunsud dio to gumawan to baloy ni Simon.

Nò, nabawian ni Hisus ka mohon-ing no mgo otow no duon loinloin no oggoramon dan woy nandogil din ka mgo busow no nigsolod to diralom to duma no mgo otow. Wa din pakagia ka mgo busow su nigtokod dan to sikandin ka Anak to Magboboot.
Ogwali si Hisus dio to Galilia
Pogpamikatpikat, nig-onow si Hisus no nighipanow dio to waro otow no dio nig-ampu.
Di waro malugoy no nigsundul no nigpamitow si Simon woy ka mgo duma rin ko hondoi buwa nigdolog.
Ko nigkita ran si Hisus, nigkagian dan sikandin to “Ogpamitow ka tibo no mgo otow koykow.”
Di nigtabak ni Hisus kandan to, “Oghipanow kinow dio to mgo dangob no mgo lunsud oyow ogwali a dio su ian ka tuud ku to poghondini ku.”
Amunaan, nighipanow on woy si Hisus no niglogoblogob dan ka mgo lunsud to Galilia oyow ogwali duon to mgo anaranan to mgo og-ampu woy pigdogil din ka mgo busow duon to lawa to mgo otow.
Nigbawian ni Hisus ka Songo Ibungon

Ko dio, nigdalapak ki Hisus ka songo otow no ibungon no nigluhud no nigbuyu to ogbuligan sikandin no kagi rin, “Ko ogkoiniatan nu ogpakabawi ka to kogang ku oyow ogkaawo ka igkaligsomi ku dio to tangkaan to mgo otow.”
Nohoy-uan ni Hisus sikandin no nigtinawo no pigsamsam din ka otow no ibungon. Kagi ni Hisus kandin, “Koiniatan ku; ogkabawian kad on.”
Naparagas do moulii. Malinis on ka lawa rin.

No nig-udlingan ni Hisus sikandin no kagi rin, “Ko nu nangoni ka agad hontow di oghondio kad nasi to talagpanubad woy ipapitow nu kandin to warad ka ibung to lawa nu; nighamulhamul on. Ibogoy nu to Magboboot ka igtubad no insugu ni Moisis to nighamulhamul kad su ian ka igpohitaga to mgo otow to warad on ka ibung nu.” Pog-udling ni Hisus kandin, pinohipanow rin on.

Di nighipanow ka sika otow no nambatbat to mgo otow no kagi rin, “Nabawian ad on ni Hisus.” Puun to kagi to sikan no nabawian, konad ogpakasolod si Hisus to agad hondoi no lunsud ko ogkitoon to mgo otow. Dio do to libuwasan to mgo lunsud og-ugpo si Hisus to waro otow woy ogkalimud dio to kandin ka mgo otow no nigpuun to agad hondoi.

footnotes.text: Ko ogbautismuan kow to Gimukud din, sikan ka ogbogayan kow tag sagboka, to Gimukud din to og-ugpo kaniu woy pinabayo to kabogbogan din, ogpakaawo to igmaligsom to goinawa now no ogkounawa to ogpakaawo ka hapuy to dangob no mgo maligsom.
Basa ka to Mga Salmo 2:7, Isaias 42:1.
Si Satanas ka igbuyag to mgo busow.
